newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Polymer expands P&G license.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Polymer expands P&G license.

text.p: Advanced Polymer Systems Inc Tuesday expanded a license and supply agreement with Procter & Gamble to include its microsponge-based dimethicone in adult wipe hygeine products.

Procter & Gamble previously received rights for use in baby wipes, which are now marketed as Pampers Rash Care. The adult wipes will be sold under the brand name Attends, Advanced Polymer said in a statement.
Advanced Polymer will receive an upfront license fee, manufacturing revenues and royalties on product sales with guaranteed minimums, it said in a statement.

"The purpose of Microsponge-based dimethicone in Attends adult wipes is to provide protection from skin rash caused by incontinence," said John Meakem, chief executive officer of Advanced Polymer. "In the United States alone, an estimated 11 million middle-aged and older adults suffer from incontinence."
Procter & Gamble plans to market the Attends adult wipe to health care institutions.
